svg.title: How the RP request fills up: a 24,000-token example
svg.desc: Fresh defaults: history 8,000 · raw tail 8,000 · blind zone 1 exchange · whole-input target 24,000 The other 3,000 / 3,000 / 2,000 are illustrative text sizes, not additional default limits. Full RP prompt target = 24,000 → an indicator reference, not a hard boundary This bar shows component sizes. WI uses its ST-configured positions; this is not exact message ordering.

g.text: How the RP request fills up: a 24,000-token example
Fresh defaults: history 8,000 · raw tail 8,000 · blind zone 1 exchange · whole-input target 24,000
The other 3,000 / 3,000 / 2,000 are illustrative text sizes, not additional default limits.
1 · Setup
2 · History
3 · Raw tail
4 · WI
5 · Protected
Full RP prompt target = 24,000 → an indicator reference, not a hard boundary
This bar shows component sizes. WI uses its ST-configured positions; this is not exact message ordering.
System + character + persona + service templates — 3,000 in this example
Usually stable. Change ST settings / character text; WorldMemory does not cap this component.
Retrieved history — soft target 8,000; selected again for each turn
WorldMemory → Max history tokens: full skeleton + expanded originals + labels; a soft allowance.
Recent original exchanges — retain roughly 8,000 without rewriting them
WorldMemory → Raw tail. Increase to retain more recent chat; whole exchanges are not cut at a token boundary.
World Info — 3,000 here: 1,000 Constant + 2,000 keyword-activated
ST → World Info: budget and entries. Constant needs no key trigger; other entries use native scanning.
Protected exchange 1,500 + current post 500 = 2,000 in this example
WorldMemory → Blind Zone = 1 exchange. Extra to Raw tail; this protection has no separate token cap.
* Soft targets: the total can exceed 24,000. WorldMemory does not clip the full request to that number.
Raising Full RP prompt target alone does not increase Max history tokens or Raw tail.
Actual model window and output reserve: ST / API settings. The future reply is not shown in this bar.
WorldMemory WI 20% applies to background summarizing (up to 4,800 with a 24,000 source batch), not this bar.
